title: Möbius formula for numerical coefficients
statement: For any $n\ge 0$, let $\varphi:(\mathbb{F}_2)^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinate set. Its numerical coefficient at $S$ is $\displaystyle \sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\varphi(\mathbf{1}_T)$, where $\mathbf{1}_T$ is $1$ on $T$ and $0$ outside $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
